recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-14202. If the unrelated DocumentReference request examples need correction, handle them under a separate tracker or human-confirmed scope rather than attaching them to this modifierExtension issue.
issue_request: FHIR-14202 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core change request for the extensibility modifierExtension section. It asked to correct the JSON example so valueBoolean is the JSON boolean true instead of the quoted string "true".
initial_application: The issue was applied in historical SVN revision 13368, mirrored as git commit 546dbb1a0e33eb4c9ffdd8ff802e86f0a7c7637d ("GF#14202 - fix json boolean examples"), which changed source/extensibility.html from "valueBoolean" : "true" to "valueBoolean" : true.
additional_context: The current source has since been reformatted and the modifierExtension example now uses a Patient.contact example, but the relevant JSON line is still an unquoted boolean. source/fhir.ini maps the Extension type page to extensibility, confirming the page is part of the current build scope. Repository-wide source grep still finds quoted valueBoolean values in unrelated DocumentReference operation request text files; those are Parameters examples outside the Jira's extensibility/modifierExtension related page and were not changed for this audit. Quoted issue-key community searches found no Zulip or Confluence record that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source change was made because the current build-scoped extensibility example already satisfies the Jira request, and changing unrelated DocumentReference examples would broaden this issue beyond its recorded scope.
